transcript: Speaker A: सीधी बात तेरा टाइम बर्बाद हो रहा है। रोज़ 4 घंटे रील्स, साल के 1460 घंटे। उसमें से 15 मिनट इंग्लिश को दे देता तो आज कहीं और होता... इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप डाउनलोड कर... ट्रायल ₹1 है... [Straight talk, you are wasting your time. 4 hours of reels daily is 1460 hours a year. If you gave 15 minutes of that to English, you'd be somewhere else today... Download English Seekho app... Trial is ₹1...] Speaker B: तो इंस्टॉल बटन पे क्लिक करो और इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप डाउनलोड करो। [So click the install button and download the English Seekho app.]
on_screen_text: English Seekho, INSTALL NOW, Disclaimer [English Seekho, INSTALL NOW, Disclaimer]
summary: A presenter on stage urges viewers to stop wasting hours on social media reels and instead dedicate just 15 minutes a day to learning English. He promotes the 'English Seekho' app, highlighting its bite-sized expert videos, AI practice coach, and a 1-rupee trial offer.
